$100M Playbook · GOATed Ads

GOATed Ad Teardowns

Every example ad from Hormozi's playbook — screenshot, transcript, and a one-line note on how it's built, tagged by his five formats. Study models for QS's own ads. Below them: a growing statics library — standalone statics and full carousels, filterable by funnel stage and format.

How every one of these is built

  • Each ad = Hook × Meat × CTA, assembled from parts — not written whole.
  • Five "meat" formats: Demonstration · Testimonial · Education · Story · Faceless.
  • The CTA is identical every time: "click the link, opt in, schedule a call time, we'll see you on the other side."
  • The strongest testimonial move is the Parade of Proof — stacked $ figures + rapid client one-liners, not one polished story.
  • Hook matched to awareness level (unaware→curiosity, problem→pain, solution→promise, product→proof, most→offer).

18 video teardowns · 12 transcribed · 3 silent (visual/music) · 15 screenshots · 14 static entries (13 standalone + 1 seven-frame carousel) · 3 competitor exemplars · filterable by stage and media.

S1

Cole Gordon — “Craziest Offer” 7-frame carousel

Structure Every frame has one job: qualify ($2,500+, phone sales) → the offer (we replace you with setters/closers) → who it’s for → social proof (Tony Robbins, Frank Kern, 4,000+ brands) → mechanism (400–1,000 interviews/mo) → risk reversal (zero-to-$30M systems, don’t pay if it fails) → CTA. Text-frame carousel — no design, the sequence is the creative.

Post caption: “Our Setters Perform. On You...”

Frame 1/7 — Hook + qualify

“I HAVE THE CRAZIEST OFFER FOR YOU — If you have a product or service over $2,500 and you sell it online through phone sales, this one is for you.”

Frame 2/7 — The offer

“THE OFFER — WE REPLACE YOU WITH SETTERS OR CLOSERS.”

Frame 3/7 — Who it’s for

“WHO IT’S FOR — SPECIFICALLY FOR HIGH-TICKET BUSINESSES. Coaches, consultants, course creators. Also agencies, B2B companies, medical device and high-ticket SaaS. Anything sold online, $2,500 or more, through phone sales.”

Frame 4/7 — Social proof

“WHO WE’VE WORKED WITH — THE BIGGEST BRANDS IN THE INDUSTRY… Like Tony Robbins, Dean Graziosi, Frank Kern, Agora Financial, Cardone Ventures, Jeff Lerner, Todd Brown, and over 4,000 others.”

Frame 5/7 — Mechanism

“HOW IT WORKS — OUR PROVEN DISTRIBUTION. We place salespeople out of our proven distribution. We interview about 400 to 1,000 people a month and get about 2,000 applications a month, then filter them down to hand you the best ones on a silver platter.”

Frame 6/7 — What you get + risk reversal

“WHAT YOU GET — THE SYSTEMS THAT SCALED US TO $30M. We give you the ramping frameworks and all the systems we used to scale our company from zero to $30 million a year in just two years. And if it doesn’t work, you don’t pay.”

Frame 7/7 — CTA

“CLICK LEARN MORE BELOW.”

You're following up but you're not getting any sort of replies on calls you've already taken. And then you're manually emailing everybody.

The problem with this is that this is twenty hours a week or more of effort for two to three unqualified calls a week. In other words, this is not worth your time anymore.

Because if you're running a successful agency, your time is valuable. The problem is is you're running a broken model.

The fact of the matter is is that agencies scaling past 50k a month, they didn't get better at cold outreach or just brute forcing their way there.
